insights.summary: PreSense routing and context help agents close more calls from digital shoppers.
insights.quote: And I'm seeing it in the numbers, our routed calls are closing better than the ones that come in cold.

insights.summary: When Genesys transfers a call between queues or agents, the PreSense screen pop arrives blank for the receiving agent.
insights.quote: So if it goes from, say, intake to a specialist queue, or an agent transfers to a supervisor, the person picking it up, their screen just shows nothing. Blank PreSense panel.
